title: OKG invariants.yaml
description: Correctness rules. Each invariant is either (a) a library reference or (b) a deployment-authored SQL body that returns violator rows.

with.description: Parameters passed to the parameterized library invariant.

source.description: Required when scope=source; names the source this invariant is scoped to.

sql.description: SQL body returning violator rows. Contract defined in docs/develop/architecture/pipeline.md#publication-result-types. Empty result set = pass; any rows = fail; rows form the sample in graph_generations.invariant_summary. Each row MUST have at minimum a node_id or edge_id column (the substrate treats this as the opaque key for deduplicating violators across runs). Evaluator runs the body inside a READ ONLY transaction and injects `LIMIT 100` if no LIMIT is present at the statement top level (LIMITs inside CTEs or subqueries do not count). Evaluator rejects bodies containing any write-statement token (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE, MERGE, COPY, CREATE, DROP, ALTER, GRANT, REVOKE, CALL, DO, SELECT INTO) at parse time, and the READ ONLY transaction is the backstop.
